t: Dine kos rishon veseder happesach ad kos sheni
s: Dine kos rishon veseder happesach ad kos sheni ubo n"g seipim: mozeg kos rishon veomer alayv qiddush hayyom. Veim epshar tob shello yimzog habbaal habbayit beatzmo, ella acher yimzog lo, sheyyehe lo kimshorto, kelomar derek cherut userarut, zeker litziat mitzrayim:

Leachar gemar haqqiddush qodem sheyyishteh hakkos — mebarek "shehecheyanu". Veim shakach lebarek qodem hashshetiyya — yebarek achar kak miyyad keshennizkar. Vaapillu nizkar lemachar bayyom — yebarek, vaapillu beemtza hashshuq. Veim nizkar leachar sheqqiddesh hayyom yom tob sheni shel galuyyot — hare hu niptar be"shehecheyanu" sheyyebarek al hakkos leachar haqqiddush. Veim shakach lebarek "shehecheyanu" beqiddush lel sheni, apillu im berak kebar belel rishon — chayyab lebarek ematay shennizkar bekol shibat yeme hechag, dehaynu ad sop yom tob haacharon shel galuyyot:

Im shakach leqaddesh ballayla — yesh lo tashlumin lemachar kemo beqiddush shel shabbat, dehaynu shellemachar bayyom yebarek "bore peri haggapen", veachar kak yebarek birkat haqqiddush "asher bachar banu ku'". Abal mi sheshshakach lomar hahaggada — en lo tashlumin bayyom, shenneemar "baabur zeh vego'", "baabur zeh" — lo amarti ella beshaa sheyyesh matztza umaror munnachim lepaneka leshem choba, dehaynu ballayla harishon, abal mikkan vaelak akilat matztza hi reshut:

En littol hayyadayim qodem qiddush ella im ken en yadayv neqiyyot. Veap hannohagim bekol yamim tobim veshabbatot littol hayyadayim lasseuda qodem qiddush, lepi shessoberin shehaqqiddush eno chashub hepseq ben netilat yadayim lasseuda hoil vehu mitztzorke hasseuda kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"a, mikkol maqom belel pesach shemmapsiqin harbeh achar haqqiddush baamirat hahaggada ubetok kak massiach dato mishshemirat yadayv, lepikak ap im yittol yadayv qodem haqqiddush — en netila zo shava kelum, veyitztarek lachazor velittol yadayv lasseuda achar hahaggada. Veap shennetila zo moelet shello yitztarek lachazor velittol yadayv achar haqqiddush qodem akilat yeraqot shemmetabbel otam bemashqeh kemo sheyyitbaer, vekol dabar shettibbulo bemashqeh tzarik netilat yadayim belo beraka kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch, mikkol maqom yoter tob sheyyittol yadayv achar haqqiddush qodem hattibbul, sheim yittol qodem haqqiddush — yesh lachosh shemma yitu miqtzat hehamon vibareku al netila zo, lepi sheyyidmeh beenehem netila zo shava lishar netilot shennotelin qodem haqqiddush bekol yamim tobim veshabbatot, shemmebarekin alehem "al netilat yadayim":

Im chal beshabbat nohagin lomar "vaykullu" qodem haqqiddush, kede lehotzi et banayv veet bene beto shello hayu bebet hakkeneset velo shameu kesheameru hatztzibbur "vaykullu" achar hattepilla. (Veayyen besiman ar"h shemmuttar lomar hahaggada leor hanner):

Im chal bemotzae shabbat tzarik lomar habdala leachar haqqiddush, veim yesh lo ner yebarek alayv qodem hahabdala leachar haqqiddush, veachar hahabdala yebarek "shehecheyanu", nimtza seder habberakot: yqnh"z. (Veim shinna hasseder shehiqdim hamuchar veecher hammuqdam — yatza, velo yachazor vibarek, chutz meim hiqdim haqqiddush lebirkat hayyayin, shetztzarik lachazor ulebarek birkat haqqiddush lepi sheasa kedibre bet shammay keneged dibre bet hillel, vekol haoseh kedibre bet shammay — lo yatza yede chobato). (Ayyen siman rch"tz). Abal en mebarekin al habbesamim bekol motzae shabbat leyom tob, lepi shemmah shemmebarekin al habbesamim bekol motzae shabbat hu kede lehashib et hannepesh shehi doebet litziat hannepesh hashshabbat mechamat neshama haytera shennittela mimmennu, ubeyom tob en tzarik libsamim, shettaanug yom tob vesimchato meshib et hannepesh:

Im shakach lehabdil velo nizkar ad leachar shehitchil hahaggada — yashlim hahaggada ad leachar "gaal yisrael" velo yishteh hakkos miyyad, ella yomar alayv birkat hanner vehahabdala veachar kak yishtennu. Veap al pi sheen osin shette mitzvot al kos echad kemo shennitbaer besiman ra"a, mikkol maqom kan i epshar beinyan acher, sheim yabdil al hakkos beemtza hahaggada — yitztarek lebarek "bore peri haggapen" al kos hahu lepi minhag medinot ellu shebbirkat kos harishon enah poteret millebarek al hakkos hashsheni kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"d, veim ken yehe nireh kemosip al minyan hakkosot shettiqqenu chakamim. (Vehu haddin im nizkar qodem amirat hahaggada miyyad leachar sheshshata kos rishon shel qiddush qodem sheakal hayraqot shel tibbul — lo yimzog miyyad kos sheni lehabdil alayv, shello yehe mosip al hakkosot. Umutab litom hayraqot qodem hahabdala, velomar kol hahaggada ad leachar "gaal yisrael", veachar kak yomar birkat hanner vehahabdala, veyishteh hakkos). Veim lo nizkar ad tok hasseuda — tzarik lehapsiq beemtza akilato miyyad shennizkar ulehabdil al hakkos, velo yebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen", ella im ken shebbeshaa shebberak "bore peri haggapen" al kos hashsheni haya dato shello lishtot od yayin betok hasseuda, ayyen siman rtz"t veqa"d. (Vehu haddin im nizkar miyyad leachar sheshshata kos hashsheni — tzarik limzog miyyad kos shelishi veyabdil alayv, velo yebarek alayv, ella im ken shebbeshaa shebberak al kos hashsheni haya dato shello lishtot od yayin betok hasseuda velo qodem hasseuda). Veim lo nizkar (ad leachar gemar hasseuda, dehaynu leachar sheakal apiqoman — lo yabdil al hakkos qodem birkat hammazon, shello yehe kemosip al hakkosot, shechakamim tiqqenu shene kosot achar hasseuda vehu yishteh shelosha (mah sheen ken baemtza shello tiqqenu kelum — en kan hosapa), ella yamtin ad leachar birkat hammazon, sheaz yomar birkat hanner vehahabdala, veyishteh hakkos shel birkat hammazon. Veim lo nizkar) ad leachar sheshshata kos shel birkat hammazon — yamtin ad leachar gemar hahallel vehahaggada, veaz yabdil al kos harebii. (Veim lo nizkar ad leachar sheshshata kos rebii — yabdil al kos chamishi, kevan shei epshar beinyan acher):

Ap shennohagin laamod bishat habdala bekol motzae shabbatot likbod hammelek sheanu melavvin oto, mikkol maqom behabdala shebbemotzae shabbat leyom tob, hoil veomerim otah betok haqqiddush — omerim otah meyushshab kemo haqqiddush, ayyen siman ra"a:

Behabdala shebbemotzae shabbat leyom tob tzarik lachtom: "hammabdil ben qodesh leqodesh". Ulepi shetztzarik lomar meen chatima samuk lachatima, lepikak hosipu lomar: "ben qedushshat shabbat liqdushshat yom tob hibdalta". Nimtza nosach habdala meiqqar haddin hu: "hammabdil ben qodesh lechol, ben or lechoshek, ben yisrael laammim, ben qedushshat shabbat liqdushshat yom tob hibdalta, baruk atta Hashem, hammabdil ben qodesh leqodesh". Veen tzarik lomar "ben yom hashshebii lesheshet yeme hammaaseh", shehare behabdala shebbekol motzae shabbat veyom tob en omerim "ben yom hashshebii lesheshet yeme hammaaseh" ella kede sheyyihyeh meen chatima samuk lachatima kemo shennitbaer besiman rtz"v, ubemotzae shabbat leyom tob shechotemin "ben qodesh leqodesh" veqabeu lomar "ben qedushshat shabbat veku'" samuk lachatima — shub en tzarik lomar: "ben yom hashshebii ku'". Ubaddorot haacharonim nahagu lomar: "ben yom hashshebii ku' ben qedushshat shabbat liqdushshat yom tob hibdalta, veet yom hashshebii mishsheshet yeme hammaaseh qiddashta, hibdalta veqiddashta et ammeka yisrael biqdushshateka, baruk atta Hashem hammabdil ku'". Vehattaam hu, lepi sheameru chakamim behabdalot shebbekol motzae shabbat veyom tob umimmotzae shabbat leyom tob: "happochet — lo yipchot mishshalosh habdalot", dehaynu "ben qodesh lechol" achat, "ben or lechoshek" shettayim, "ben yisrael laammim" shalosh, chutz min "ben yom hashshebii ku'", o "ben qedushshat shabbat ku'", shehen enan mimminyan hashshalosh hahabdalot, sheen omerim otam ella kede sheyyihyeh meen hachatima samuk lachatima, umi sherotzeh lehosip behabdalot yakol lehosip ad shiba, keneged shiba reqiim, ulepikak bemotzae shabbat leyom tob mechamat chobat hayyom nahagu lehosip behabdalot kede lomar paam achat shiba habdalot, dehaynu shalosh shebbekol motzae shabbat veyom tob, rebiit "ben yom hashshebii ku'", dekevan sheeno samuk lachatima hu oleh min hamminyan, chamishit "ben qedushshat shabbat ku', veet yom hashshebii mishsheshet yeme hammaaseh", dehaynu mechullo shel moed — "qiddashta", vehakkol habdala achat, shehashshabbat mubdal miyyom tob umechullo shel moed, "hibdalta veqiddashta ku'" — hen shette habdalot, ben kohanim lilviyyim ben leviyyim leyisrael, ushette habdalot ellu hen meen chatima, shehi ben qodesh leqodesh:

Achar kos rishon lo yebarek beraka acharona apillu shata rebiit veyoter, ben shehu yayin ben shehu shear mashqin shehem chamar medina, lepi shehakkos shel qiddush hu mitztzorke hasseuda, vahare hu kaddebarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda sheenam tzerikim beraka leacharehem, lepi shehem tepelim lasseuda veniptarim bebirkat hammazon shelleachar hasseuda, kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"d veqa"z. Veod, shehu niptar bibraka acharona sheyyebarek achar kos rebii. Veap al pi sheshshoteh harbeh benetayim — en bekak kelum (shehare kol zeman shello nitakkel bemeayv yakol lebarek alayv beraka acharona, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"d, vekol zeman shehaitztomeka petucha leekol eno mitakkel, kemo shennitbaer sham):

Im rotzeh lishtot kamma kosot, ben miyyad leachar haqqiddush ben beemtza hahaggada qodem shehitchil birkat "asher gealanu ku'" — hareshut beyado meiqqar haddin. Veap al pi ken rauy lehizzaher shello lishtot yayin velo shum mashqeh hamshakker qodem shessiyyem hahaggada veshata kos sheni im lo letzorek harbeh, shello yishtakker veyimmana miqqeriat hahaggada. Abal leachar sheshshata kos sheni yakol lishtot yayin hen rab hen meat apillu qodem hasseuda. Veap al pi shennitbaer besiman ta"a sheasur lishtot yayin meat beereb pesach mippene [she]keshehu shoteh mimmennu meat hu soed et halleb velo yokal ballayla matztza leteabon, mikkol maqom akshav sheshshoteh b' kosot shel qiddush veshel hahaggada, apillu kesheshshoteh od meat — hare zeh niqra harbeh im shene kosot hallalu vegorer et taavat hammaakal. Mah sheen ken kesheshshoteh meat beereb pesach — en oto hamat mitztarep im shene kosot hallalu lihyot niqra harbeh, kevan sheyyesh shehut harbeh benetayim:

Vekol zeh keshehu beinyan sheen tzarik lebarek "bore peri haggapen" al mah sherotzeh lishtot, kegon shebbeshaa shebberak al kos harishon o hashsheni haya dato lishtot od yayin achar kak betok hasseuda o qodem hasseuda. Abal im lo haya dato lishtot od yayin veachar kak nimlak lishtot od (qodem hasseuda), kevan shehu tzarik lebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen" kederek shehu mebarek al kol d' kosot lepi minhag medinot ellu — hare zeh nireh kemosip al minyan hakkosot:

Umikkol maqom, muttar lishtot shear mashqin ap shehu beinyan shetztzarik lebarek alehem, sheeno nireh kemosip al hakkosot, shehare had' kosot hen shel yayin. Ubimqomot sheshshear mashqin hem chamar medina (ap al pi shehu shoteh d' kosot shel yayin — ap al pi ken) asur lo lishtot od ki im hammashqeh sheeno chamar medina im hu beinyan shetztzarik lebarek al mah sherotzeh lishtot od:

Achar sheshshatu kos rishon — tzarik kol echad veechad leekol meat yeraqot betibbul, dehaynu sheyyitbelennu bechometz o beme melach o bishar mine tibbulim. Veim en lo — yitbelennu bacharoset. Velamma tiqqenu chakamim dabar zeh? Kede lehatmiah et hattinoqot, sheyyiru shinnuy sheokelin yeraqot betibbul sheen derek leoklam qodem hasseuda bekol yemot hashshana, veyishalu al shinnuy zeh, sheamirat hahaggada mitzvatah leomrah derek teshuba al sheelot sheshshealuhu, shenneemar "ki yishaleka binka vego', veamarta lebinka abadim hayinu vego'":

Vekevan sheakila zo enah ella lehatmiah et hattinoqot, lepikak en tzarik kezayit kishar akilot shebbattora sheenah niqret akila bepachot mikkezayit, ella apillu bemashshehu day lehatmiah hattinoqot. (Veap mi sheyyosheb yechidi veen lepanayv tinoqot sheyyishalu oto — ap al pi ken chayyab betibbul zeh, shello chillequ chakamim):

Venohagin lachazor achar yaraq hanniqra "karpas" (ayp"k bilshon ashkenaz), lepi shehu noteriqon "s' perek", kelomar shishshim ribbo abedu abodat perek. Veim en lo karpas — yiqqach yaraq acher meezeh min yaraq sheyyirtzeh. Ubilbad shello yihyeh mehayraqot sheyyotzein bo yede chobat maror, sheim yokal akshav mehen — ek yachazor vibarek betok hasseuda "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al akilat maror", kevan shekkebar akal mimmennu qodem laken:

Vetzarik sheyyihyeh hayyaraq mimmine yeraqot shebbirkatan hi "bore peri haadama" kesheokelan chayyim, kede sheyyippater millebarek "bore peri haadama" al hammaror sheyyokal betok hasseuda. Veap al pi shemmapsiq benetayim bahaggada — en bekak kelum, mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman ta"d. Ulepikak, lo yebarek "bore nepashot rabbot" achar yaraq zeh apillu akal mimmennu kezayit, kede shello yitztarek lebarek "bore peri haadama" al hammaror. Veachar hammaror gam ken en tzarik lebarek "bore nepashot rabbot" apillu akal mehayyaraq kezayit, dekevan shehammaror niptar bebirkat "bore peri haadama" sheal hayraqot, laken gam hayraqot niptarim bibraka acharona shel hammaror, dehaynu bebirkat hammazon, shehammaror hu ba betok hasseuda vehu tapel lasseuda veniptar bebirkat hammazon, kemo shear perot habbaim betok hasseuda sheen tzarik lebarek leacharayv, shehem niptarim bebirkat hammazon. Veim era shebberak "bore nepashot rabbot" achar hayraqot — tzarik lebarek "bore peri haadama" al hammaror. Veken im en lo ella yeraqot shebbirkatan hi "shehakkol" keshehem chayyim — tzarik lebarek "bore peri haadama" al hammaror. Veyesh choleqim al kol zeh veomerim shekkevan shemmapsiqin harbeh ben akilat hayraqot laakilat hammaror bahaggada vehallel, lepikak en hammaror niptar be"bore peri haadama" sheal hayraqot, umah sheen tzarik lebarek "bore peri haadama" al hammaror, hu mishshum shehammaror hu mitztzorke hasseuda, shechayyab hu leekol maror achar hammatztza miyyad, vahare hem kaddebarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda betok hasseuda sheenam tzerikim beraka lipnehem, shehem tepelim lappat, veniptarim bebirkat "hammotzi", kemo shennitbaer besiman qa"z. Vekevan shehammaror eno niptar bebirkat "bore peri haadama" sheal hayraqot — chayyab hu lebarek "bore nepashot rabbot" achar hayraqot im akal kezayit:

Uleinyan halaka — yesh lachosh leb' hassebarot. Velaken lo yokal mehayraqot kezayit shalem, shello yitztarek lebarek acharayv "bore nepashot rabbot" lepi sebara haacharona. Veim era sheakal kezayit — lo yebarek "bore nepashot rabbot", shello yebarek lebattala lepi sebara harishona. Veim era shebberak "bore nepashot rabbot", veken im en lo ella yeraqot shebbirkatan "shehakkol" keshehen chayyim — ap al pi ken lo yebarek "bore peri haadama" al hammaror, shello yebarek lebattala lepi sebara hab':

Qodem shemmetabbel hayyaraq bechometz o beme melach vekayyotze bahem — tzarik littol yadayv belo beraka, kemo shennitbaer besiman qn"ch, shekkol dabar shettibbulo bemashqeh tzarik netila belo beraka. (Veayyen besiman shk"a sheim chal pesach beshabbat — yakol laasot hamme melach beshabbat, ubilbad shello yaaseh ella meat mizzeer mah shetztzarik letibbul zeh bilbad. Ulepi sheqqasheh haddabar letzamtzem kol kak, laken yaaseh hamme melach meereb shabbat. Veim shakach — yaaseh beshabbat meat mizzeer):

Achar sheakal hayraqot yabiu lipne mi sheomer hahaggada g' matztzot shel mitzva kede lomar alehem hahaggada, shenneemar "lechem oni", vedareshu chakamim: "lechem sheonin alayv debarim harbeh", dehaynu amirat hahaggada. Veod neemar "vehiggadta lebinka bayyom hahu lemor baabur zeh vego'", "baabur zeh" — lo amarti ella beshaa sheyyesh matztza umaror munnachim lepaneka, lepikak tzarik sheyyehe gam hammaror lepanayv bishat amirat hahaggada. Veod, shetztzarik lomar alayv "maror zeh ku'". Vetiqqenu sheyyihyeh lepanayv charoset bishat amirat hahaggada, shehacharoset hu zeker lattit shennishtaabbedu bo abotenu bemitzrayim vezeker lattappuach kemo she[yi]tebbaer, lekak tzarik lihyot al hashshulchan beshaa shemmesapper shibud mitzrayim. Ubizman shebbet hammiqdash qayyam — haya tzarik lehabi gam et happesach bishat amirat hahaggada. Veakshav shecharab bet hammiqdash — tiqqenu chakamim sheyyihyu al hashshulchan bishat amirat hahaggada shene mine tabshilin, echad zeker lappesach veechad zeker lachagiga, veechad mehattabshilin (nahagu sheyyihyeh) basar, vehashsheni yakol lihyot apillu hammaraq shennitbashshel bo habbasar. Ukebar nahagu middorot harishonim shehabbasar yihyeh mippereq hanniqra "zeroa", lizkor sheggealam haqqadosh baruk hu bizroa netuya, vehashsheni yihyeh betza, lepi shehu "bea" bilshon arammi, kelomar debaa rachamana lemipraq yatana bidraa meromema. Veyakol laasotan ben tzeluyin ben mebushshalin meiqqar haddin:

Venahagu shehabbasar yihyeh tzali al haggechalim, zeker lappesach shehaya tzeli esh. Veap shehappesach haya nitzla beshappud lekattechilla, mikkol maqom kevan shei epshar litzlot habbasar beshappud shehappesach nitzla bo, shehappesach lo haya nitzla ella beshappud shel rimmon, vetorach hu lachazor achar shappud shel rimmon, lepikak tzolin al gabbe gechalim, sheap happesach shennitzla al gabbe gechalim — kasher. Vehabbetza osin ben tzeluya ben mebushshelet, veokelin otah betok hasseuda kemo she[yi]tebbaer besiman ta"v. Abal habbasar en nohagin leoklo ballayla hazzeh apillu bemaqom shennohagin hetter baakilat basar tzali ballayla, mikkol maqom zeh habbasar shemmebiin oto zeker lappesach im yoklennu belayla zeh — yehe nireh keokel qadashim bachutz. Lepikak im shakach litzlotan meereb yom tob — lo yitzleh beyom tob mishshechoshka, ella im ken dato leoklo lemachar bayyom. Abal im dato lehanicho lallayla hashsheni — asur litzloto belayla rishon. Veken yizzaher keshetzoleh ballayla hashsheni sheyyokal lemachar bayyom, velo yenichem ad hallayla:
Tzarik lizzaher sheyyihyeh meat basar karuk al haetzem hazzeroa, sheetzem belo basar eno niqra tabshil:

Im chal pesach bemotzae shabbat ap shello hayeta chagiga neekelet belayla zeh, lepi shei epshar leshachatah ulehaqribah beshabbat, vegam i epshar lehaqribah beereb shabbat, shehare enah neekelet ella lishne yamim velayla echad shebben hashsheni yamim, ap al pi ken tzarik lehabi shene tabshilim, echad zeker lappesach veechad zeker lachagiga, dekevan sheen mebiin ella lezeker beolma — en lachosh im lo hayeta chagiga neekelet belayla zeh, veadderabba hamdaqdeq bazeh nireh sheoseh otan kemin qadashim mammash:

Kol debarim ellu, dehaynu hammatztzot vehammaror vehacharoset ushene tabshilin — en tzarik lehabi ella lipne mi sheomer hahaggada, dehaynu lipne baal habbayit, abal bene habbayit shehen yotzein bishmia mibbaal habbayit (shekken nakon laasot mishshum "berab am hadrat melek" kemo shennitbaer besiman ch') — en tzarik sheyyihyu debarim ellu lipnehem, lo bishat shemiat hahaggada velo bishat hasseuda, shebbaal habbayit yechalleq matztza umaror vacharoset lekol echad veechad, sheap shebbeyom tob tzarik libtzoa al lechem mishneh, mikkol maqom kevan shehem yotzein bebirkat "hammotzi" shel baal habbayit — hem yotzeim gam ken belechem mishneh shel baal habbayit:

Venahagu lehabi kol debarim ellu lipne baal habbayit miyyad achar qiddush qodem akilat hayraqot (kede sheyyihyeh haqqiddush samuk lehatchalat hasseuda, dehaynu habaat hammatztza vehammaror, ayyen siman ra"a). Uleachar sheakelu mehayraqot — yakol lesalleq meal hashshulchan et mah shennishtayyer mehayraqot vehachometz o me hammelach:

Keshemmebi lepanayv hayraqot im kol debarim ellu — tob sheyyesadderem lepanayv baqqeara beinyan shello yitztarek laabor al hammitzvot, dehaynu shehayraqot yihyu semukim lo yoter min hammatztza, vehammatztza min hammaror vacharoset, vehammaror vehacharoset min shene tabshilin. Veyesh sheen maqpidin al hacharoset ushene tabshilin im yihyu semukim elayv, dekevan sheenan bain al hashshulchan ella lezeker beolma — lo shayyak etzlam "en maabirin al hammitzvot". Vegam al hammaror en maqpidin im yihyeh samuk lo, dekevan sheeno chabib al haadam veen lo din qedima leinyan birkat hannehenin, laken gam kan en maqpidin im yitztarek laabor alayv ulebarek al hayraqot battechilla veachar kak al hammatztza veachar kak al hammaror. Veal zeh somekim hannohagim mittaam hayyadua lahem lesadder kol debarim ellu al gabbe hammatztza, dehaynu leachar shessidderu hammatztzot betok haqqeara kesidran: kohen milmala, velevi tachtayv, veyisrael tachtayv — mesadderin al gabbe hakkohen hazzeroa shel taleh miyyamin, vehabbetza missemol, vehammaror lematta meat keneged emtzaam keen seggo"l, veachar kak hacharoset miyyamin, vehakkarpas missemol, vehammaror shel kerika lematta meat keneged emtzaam keen seggo"l sheni:

Ellu yeraqot sheadam yotze bahen yede chobat maror: bachazeret (sheqqorin sal"t) bilshon ashkenaz, ubelashon separad salata, veshem haetzem shello hu latoga btvgrm"a veitalya veashkenaz uporetgal, ubesipre harepuot niqra latiga salat, veeno matzuy bizman happesach ella bammedinot hachammot, veeno yaraq hanniqra zarzv"k bilshon polin[)], beulshin (sheqqorin anadiby), betamka (sheqqorin qarin o maratak, ubelaaz marobiia), becharchabina (sheqqorin baraby alaqaratzina), ubemaror (sheqqorin voaramat bilshon ashkenaz, vehu laana), lepi shenneemar battora maror setam, veqibbelu chakamim sheen shum min yaraq mar niqra beshem maror setam ella h' mine yeraqot ellu:

Chamishsha minim hallalu mitztorpot likzayit. Veyotzeim bahem ben bealin ben biqlachim, abal lo besharashim, dehaynu sharashim haqqetannim hammitpatztzelim lekan ulekan. Abal hashshoresh haggadol shebbo gedelim healim ap shehu tamun baqqarqa — hare zeh biklal qelach. Umikkol maqom, tob yoter littol healim vehaqqelach hayyotze chutz laqqarqa, lepi sheyyesh omerim shemmah shehu tamun baqqarqa hu niqra shoresh. Abal haiqqar hu kassebara harishona:

Healin en yotzein bahen ella im ken hem lachin, abal lo kemushim, veen tzarik lomar yebeshim (ayyen siman trm"ch). Abal haqqelachim yotzein bahem ben lachim ben yebeshim, veen tzarik lomar kemushim, dekevan shehaqqelach hu ab — en taam merirato nipsad al yede shemmityabbesh. Abal en yotzein beqelach mebushshal, lepi shennipsad taam merirato al yede habbishshul, vehakkabush hu kimbushshal, dehaynu im nishra betzir o bechometz chazaq veshaha sham bikde sheim hayu notenin hatztzir vehachometz al gabbe haur hayu matchilin lehartiach. Veken im nishra meet leet apillu bemayim tzonenim — en yotzein bo. Umiqtzat hehamon en nizharin, venahagu lishrot hammaror yoter mimmeet leet betzonen kede lehapig merirato qetzat. Veyesh mi shemmeyashsheb minhagam lomar sheap shehashsharuy bemayim meet leet niqra kabush, vahare hu kimbushshal leinyan kol issurim shebbattora, mikkol maqom leinyan maror eno kimbushshal ella im ken kabush bechometz vetzir, lepi shettaam hachometz o hatztzir meshanneh umebattel taam merirut hammaror hannikbash bahem legamre, abal hammayim en mebattelin hamrirut ella mepigin taamo qetzat, vekol shello nikbash bechometz vetzir adayin yesh bo merirut qetzat. Veod, sheap bekol issurim yesh omerim shello ameru "kabush kimbushshal" ella kabush bechometz vetzir, velo bemayim. Veap sheanu machamirin bekol issurim, mikkol maqom leinyan maror en lehachamir, shehi chumra habbaa lide qulla, bimqomot sheen chazeret matzuy veokelin hattamka lemitzvat maror, umechamat chariputo en yekolin leekol mimmennu kezayit, velaken shorin oto bemayim yom o yomayim lehapig merirato qetzat. Umikkol maqom, tob lehotzi mehammayim tok meet leet, veyachazor veyashrennu sham, shekkesheeno sharuy bemayim k"d shaot retzupim — eno niqra kabush ledibre hakkol:

Ap al pi shekkol h' minim ellu niqraim maror bilshon tora, mikkol maqom middibre soperim mitzva lachazor achar chazeret apillu liqnoto bedamim yeqarim, al derek sheyyitbaer besiman tar[n]"v leinyan etrog hadur ayyen sham. Veap al pi shehachazeret en bah merirut, mikkol maqom keshehi shoha baqqarqa mitqashsheh haqqelach shellah venaaseh mar meod, umippene kak hi niqret maror. Umitzva lachazor achareha ap keshehi metuqa, lepi shemmitzvat maror hi zeker lemah shemmereru hammitzrim et chayye abotenu baabodat perek, vehem nishtabedu bahem bitchilla bepeh rak al yede piyyusim, venatenu lahem sakar, ulebassop mereru chayyehem baaboda qasha, laken yesh leekol hachazeret shettechillatah metuqa verakka vesopah qasheh vamar, dehaynu keshehaqqelach shellah mitqashsheh keetz venaaseh mar kallaana:

Veim en lo chazeret — yachazir achar ulshin. Veim en lo ulshin — yachazir achar tamka. Veim en lo tamka — yachazir achar charchabina. Veim en lo charchabina — azay yiqqach hammaror, dehaynu laana. Veim en lo apillu maror — yiqqach ezeh yaraq mar sheyyirtzeh, lepi sheyyesh omerim shekkol yaraq mar sherauy laakila niqra maror bilshon tora. Vehu sheyyesh lo sarap (perush keshemmechattekin bo vesochatin oto bimqom chittuko yotze mimmennu mohal laban kechalab) upanayv maksipin, dehaynu shealeh shello eno yaroq meod kaale hakkereshim ubetzalim ushear yeraqot, ella noteh qetzat leloben hannoteh leshacharut sheqqorin (blyykly"k bilshon ashkenaz). Umikkol maqom, lo yebarek alehem, shehaiqqar hu kassebara harishona. (Veim en lo yaraq sheyyesh lo sarap upanayv maksipin — tob sheyyokal ezeh yaraq acher sheyyesh bo merirut qetzat lezeker beolma, veen tzarik kezayit. Veken) mi shehu choleh o istenis veeno yakol leekol maror — tob sheyyilos meat ad sheyyargish taam merirut bepiv lezeker beolma belo beraka, vezehu keshei epshar lo kelal. Abal chayyab adam lidchoq et atzmo leqayyem mitzvat chakamim leekol kezayit shalem ap im yikob alayv. Veshiur kezayit yitbaer besiman tp"v ayyen sham:

Hacharoset tzarik lihyot ab, lepi shehu zeker lattit shennishtaabbedu bo abotenu, veachar kak tzarik lerakkek oto bemashqeh zeker laddam. Veyesh lerakkeko bemashqeh adom, kegon chometz o yayin adummim. Veyesh laasot hacharoset mipperot shennimshelu bahem keneset yisrael, kegon teenim, shenneemar "hatteena chonta paggeha", veegozim, shenneemar "el ginnat egoz", utemarim, shenneemar "eeleh betamar", verimmonim, shenneemar "kepelach harimmon", vetappuchim, zeker le"tachat hattappuach orartika", shehayu yoledot sham benehem belo etzeb, usheqedim, al shem sheshshaqad haqqadosh baruk hu al haqqetz laasot. Umeiqqar haddin yakol laasoto apillu miraqot, ulerakkeko apillu bemayim ushear mashqin. Abal al kol panim, tzarik litten letoko dabar sheyyesh bo qiyyuha, kegon tappuchim o yayin vechometz, zeker lashshibud shehayu mishtabedim beyisrael ad shehayu shinnehem qehot:

Vetzarik litten betoko tablin haddomin leteben, kegon qinnamon vezangebil sheenan niddokin hadeq heteb veyesh bahen leachar haddika chutin qashin vaarukkin qetzat kemo teben, zeker latteben shehayu megabbelin betok hattit:

Im chal pesach beshabbat — tzarik lizzaher lerakkek hacharoset bemashqeh meereb shabbat. Veim shakach lerakkeko meereb shabbat — yerakkeko beshabbat al yede shinnuy, dehaynu shemmittechilla yitten hammashqeh letok hakkeli veachar kak yitten letoko hacharoset, veyakol leorbo beetzbao o ochez bakkeli umenaanea ad sheyyitareb, ayyen siman shk"a:

Achar sheakelu mehayraqot betibbul — tzarik liqqach matztza haemtzait mishshalosh matztzot hammunnachim lepanayv baqqeara velibtzoa miqtzatah mittaam sheyyitbaer. Venahagu kol yisrael shemmiqtzat zeh shebbotzeim mehammatztza osin bo gam ken mitzva acheret, dehaynu shemmeshammerin oto laapiqoman. Ulepikak, nakon haddabar sheyyihyeh miqtzat hazzeh rob hammatztza, sheapiqoman hi mitzva chashuba, shehu lanu bimqom happesach. Venohagin lehatznio tachat hammappa, zeker le"misharotam tzerurot besimlotam". Veyesh shekkorekin oto bemitpachat umesimin al shikmam, zeker litziat mitzrayim:

Umiqtzatah hashsheni tzarik lehachaziro laqqeara velitten oto betok shette matztzot hashshelemot, kede lomar alayv hahaggada, lepi shetztzarik lomar hahaggada al matztza harauy latzet bah yede choba, shenneemar "tokal alayv matztzot lechem oni", vedareshu chakamim sheonin alayv debarim harbeh, umittok shenneemar "lechem oni" chaser va"v, dareshu chakamim: "lechem ani", mah darko shel ani biprusa — ap kan biprusa, shehammatztza sheyyotze bah yede chobato lo tihyeh shelema ella perusa, vealeha yomar hahaggada (ubesiman ta"h yitbaer lamma mesimin oto betok shette hashshelemot). Achar kak nohagin lehagbiah haqqeara shebbah hammatztzot, veomerim "he lachma veku'" ad "mah nishtanna". Veen tzarik lehasir hattabshilin mehaqqeara qodem hahagbaha, ella yakol lehagbihah im kol haddebarim shealeha:

Yesh medaqdeqim lomar "kehe lachma" o "he kelachma", lepi sheen shayyak lomar "he lachma di akalu abhatana", shehare en zeh hallechem mammash sheakelu abotenu. Ulepikak, ap shebbekol hasseparim hannosach hu: "he lachma", mikkol maqom, haomer: "kehe lachma" o "he kelachma" — lo hipsid:

Bime chakme haggemara shehayu lahem shulchanot qetannim lipne kol echad veechad mehamsubbin — hitzriku chakamim laaqor millipne mi sheomer hahaggada et hashshulchan haqqatan shellepanayv im hammatztzot hammunnachot alayv ulehannicham bezavit acheret, kede sheyyiru hattinoqot veyishalu: lamma mesirin hammatztzot vaadayin lo akalnu, veal yede ken yitoreru lishol gam ken shear hashsheelot: "mah nishtanna ku"', kemo sheyyitbaer. Ubaddorot haacharonim shekkol hamsubbin okelin al shulchan echad gadol veyesh torach gadol baaqirato — nahagu laaqor haqqeara shebbah hammatztzot millipne baal habbayit haomer hahaggada ulehannicho besop hashshulchan keillu kebar akelu, kede sheyyishalu hattinoqot. Veakshav en nohagin apillu baaqirat haqqeara, lepi shehattinoqot yodein sheiqqar haakila lo tihyeh mimmatztzot ellu shebbaqqeara, ulepikak lo yishalu kelum kesheyyesiren meal hashshulchan:
Achar kak tzarik limzog kos sheni. Veen tzarik shetipa vahadacha, shehare shetapo vehedicho qodem haqqiddush:

Veap al pi sheen tzarik leechoz hakkos beyado ad sheyyaggia li"lepikak" kemo sheyyitbaer, ap al pi ken tzarik limzog miyyad qodem hatchalat amirat hahaggada, kede sheyyishalu hattinoqot: lamma shotin kos sheni qodem hasseuda, sheen derek lishtot ken bekol yemot hashshana, veal yede kak yitoreru lishol gam ken shear hashsheelot: "mah nishtanna veku'", leqayyem lebanayv mah shenneemar: "ki yishaleka binka machar lemor ma haedot vehachuqqim vehammishpatim vego', veamarta lebinka abadim hayinu veku'". Veim en daat babben lishol — hare abiv chayyab lelammedo lishol "mah nishtanna ku'". Veim en lo ben — hare ishto chayyebet lishol oto. Veim en lo ishsha — hu shoel et atzmo "mah nishtanna ku'". Vaapillu im mesubbin shene talmide chakamim habbeqiim behilkot pesach — shoel echad mehem et chabero "mah nishtanna ku'". Veachar kak matchilin shenehem "abadim hayinu", veen hashsheni tzarik lomar "mah nishtanna". Veken keshehabben o haishsha shoalin oto — en hu tzarik lomar "mah nishtanna", ella matchil "abadim hayinu":

Tzarik lomar: "en anu matbilin apillu paam echat". Abal en lomar: "en anu chayyabim letabbel apillu paam echat", lepi sheek yomar: "hallayla hazzeh shette peamim", sheyyihyeh mashma shechayyabim lehatbil shette peamim, ubeemet en matbilin mechamat chiyyub ella paam achat, dehaynu hammaror shemmatbilin bacharoset, abal tibbul harishon eno mechamat chiyyub, ella kede lehatmiah hattinoqot:

Ulepi dato shel ben abiv melammedo hatteshuba al sheelotayv, dehaynu amirat hahaggada, shehi mitzvat aseh min hattora apillu im lo shaal oto habben kelum, shenneemar "vehiggadta lebinka bayyom hahu vego'". Ulepikak, tzarik lomar hahaggada belashon shemmebinim haqqetannim vehannashim, o yeparesh lahem hainyan lepi datam, im hem mebinim harbeh — yeparesh lahem hakkol:

Veiqqar nosach hahaggada shettiqqenu chakamim choba al hakkol, hu mittechillat "abadim hayinu" ad "hare zeh meshubbach", veachar kak "mittechilla obede aboda zara hayu abotenu ku'" ad sop derush "parashat arammi obed abi", veachar kak "pesach shehayu okelin ku', matztza zo ku', maror zeh ku', bekol dor vador ku', veotanu hotzi mishsham ku', lepikak ku'", ad "baruk atta Hashem gaal yisrael". Ushear kol nosach hahaggada hu minhag shennahagu kol yisrael middorot harishonim:

Bizman shehayu mesirin hashshulchan o haqqeara millipne haomer haggada — hayu tzerikim lehachaziran lepanayv keshemmatchil "abadim hayinu", lepi shetztzarik lomar hahaggada al matztza umaror vacharoset ushene tabshilin kemo shennitbaer lemala. Velaken yesh lizzaher shettehe hammatztza megulla qetzat ad sheyyaggia li"lepikak", sheaz nohagin lehagbiah kol echad koso veleechoz beyado ad shechotem "gaal yisrael". Ulepikak, nakon lekassot hammatztzot shello yireh happat boshto keshennotelin hakkos. Veken kesheomer "vehi sheomda ku'", yesh nohagin leechoz hakkos bayyad ad "vehaqqadosh baruk hu matztzilenu miyyadam" — nakon gam ken shettehe hammatztza mekussa ad sheyyaamid hakkos al hashshulchan, veaz yegallenna:

Kesheyyaggia le"matztza zo sheanu okelin ku'" — tzarik lehagbiah hammatztza leharotah lehamsubbin shettechabeb hammitzva alehem. Veyesh lehagbiah haemtzait happerusa shehi niqret "lechem oni" ubah hu yotze yede chobato kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veken kesheyyaggia le"maror zeh" — tzarik lehagbiah hammaror leharoto lammesubbin. Abal kesheyyomar "pesach (zeh) shehayu abotenu ku'" — lo yagbiah hattabshil shebbaqqeara shehu zeker lappesach, shello yehe nireh keillu hiqdisho lekak:

"Veneemar lepanayv shira chadasha haleluyah" — tzarik lomar hannu"n shel "veneemar" besego"l, veyihyeh perusho shekkebar ameru lepanayv mosheh veyisrael betzetam mimmitzrayim "shira chadasha", dehaynu shirat hayyam, vegam yesh omerim shemmosheh veyisrael ameru et hahallel. Abal lo yomar hannu"n becholam, [ve]yihyeh perusho al geulla haatida, im ken haya tzarik lomar: "venomar lepanayv shir chadash", bilshon zakar, shekkak ameru bammidrash: kol hashshirot niqraot "shira" leshon neqeba, ki teshuatam keyoledet shehimlita zakar veniptera mitztzaar halleda veachar kak chozeret veyoledet betzaar, kak kol haggeullot hayu acharehen galuyyot vetzarot, abal geulla acharona lo tihyeh achareha tzara kelal, lekak neemar "shiru laHashem shir chadash", leshon zakar. Ulepikak, tzarik lomar bebirkat "asher gealanu": "venodeh leka shir chadash", velo yomar "shira chadasha":
En mebarekin al hahallel sheqqorin belayla zeh, lepi sheen qorin otah bepaam echad, ella qorin miqtzato lipne hasseuda umiqtzato leachar birkat hammazon:

Ap al pi sheqqeriat hahallel hi meummad kemo shennitbaer besiman t"k, mikkol maqom hahallel shebbelayla zeh qorin apillu meyushshab, lepi shekkol maase layla zeh hu derek cherut, lepikak en matrichin oto laamod. Umikkol maqom, lo yiqra hahallel vehahaggada keshehu mutteh al tziddo, ella yesheb beema ubeyira, ayyen siman s"g:

Bebirkat "asher gealanu" tzarik lomar "min hazzebachim" veachar kak "min happesachim", lepi shehazzebach hi hachagiga hanneekelet belayla zeh qodem akilat happesach, kede sheyyihyeh happesach neekal al hassoba. Ukeshechal pesach bemotzae shabbat — yesh medaqdeqin lomar: "min happesachim umin hazzebachim", shehare en chagiga neekelet belayla zeh kemo shennitbaer lemala, vehazzebachim hem hachagiga veshalme simcha shemmaqribin lemachar bayyom. Veyesh sheen medaqdeqin bekak veomerim hakkol nosach echad, shehare anu mebaqqeshim she"yaggienu Hashem lemoadim habbaim sasim baabodato", vesham nokal leshana habbaa, keshello yihyeh pesach bemotzae shabbat, min hazzebachim mittechilla, dehaynu mechagiga shenneekelet belayla zeh, veachar kak min happesachim. Vaapillu im al pi cheshbon haqqebiut hammasur beyadenu yihyeh pesach habba bemotzae shabbat, mikkol maqom, kesheyyibbaneh bet hammiqdash yeqaddeshu al pi hareiyya, veepshar shello yihyeh bemotzae shabbat:

Nohagin lizroq meat min hakkos keshemmaggia le"dam vaesh vetimrot ashan", veken keshemmazkir hammakkot bishmotan biprat, veken keshemmazkiran biklal, dehaynu "detza"ke ada"sh beacha"b", sak hakkol y"v peamim, keneged charbo shel haqqadosh baruk hu shenniqret yvh"k, vehu malak hamemunneh al hanneqama:

Venohagin lizroq meat min hakkos beetzbao hassamuk laggudal, shehu niqra etzba setam, remez al mah shekkatub "etzba elohim hi". Veyesh nohagin lizroq baetzba hanniqra qemitza, lepi shebbeetzba zo hikka haqqadosh baruk hu lemitzrayim, veyesh nohagin mittaam hayyadua lahem lizroq min hakkos atzmo, shello al yede etzba:
Suma chayyab biqriat hahaggada o bishmiatah min hattora. Ulepikak, hu motzi harabbim yede chobatan, ap im hu suma meet hivvoldo:
Maaseh beechad shehaya tapus bide nokrim velo yada baamirat hahaggada beal peh, vehaya lo chummash veamar kol happarashiyyot shel yetziat mitzrayim:
